familySummary: Bacoli shelves pair a tall, cabinet-style profile with natural oak tones, offering a practical way to organise and display everyday items.
familyDescription: The Bacoli collection brings a clean, vertical presence to shelving and display. With a natural oak finish, it suits spaces that call for a simple, understated look while helping keep books, objects and tableware neatly arranged. This family is defined by its cabinet-style form and balanced proportions, making it suitable for living areas, dining spaces or hallways. The design focuses on everyday storage and display, with materials and dimensions chosen to support a composed, streamlined appearance.
